items.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated' including reopening Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Tehran also signals progress on talks but says the key issue of nuclear weapons is not part of an initial framework it is working on.

items.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
items.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

items.title: Red Cross volunteers die from suspected Ebola in DR Congo
items.description: They are thought to have caught the virus before the outbreak was identified, the Red Cross says.

items.title: French mum and partner held until trial after sons abandoned by road in Portugal
items.description: The couple, who allegedly left the woman's sons on a roadside in southern Portugal, will remain in custody.

items.title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
items.description: Ukraine says it struck Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied region.

items.title: F1 great Prost 'injured as masked gang raid home'
items.description: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Alain Prost was injured when a masked gang raided his home near Geneva, Swiss media reports.

items.title: Nascar champion Kyle Busch died of pneumonia and sepsis, family says
items.description: The driver died aged 41 on Thursday after "overwhelming complications" from the illnesses.

items.title: Rubio meets Modi during India visit with energy high on agenda
items.description: The secretary of state wants to sell US energy to Delhi to make up for shortfalls caused by the Iran war.

items.title: California declares state of emergency as fire crews race to contain toxic chemical leak
items.description: Thousands have been evacuated as officials warn a tank containing about 7,000 gallons of methyl methacrylate could explode.

items.title: Senegal's president sacks PM and former ally after months-long feud
items.description: Bassirou Diomaye Faye also dissolved the government, creating uncertainty amid a debt crisis in the country.

items.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
items.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

items.title: India's parody 'cockroach party' claims website has been blocked
items.description: The satirical group has gained millions of followers as "the voice of the lazy and unemployed".
